description:
Remotion tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- create_remotion_composition: Upload a finalized Remotion project ONCE as a zip of its source: the registerRoot entry point and its files, no node_modules.
- update_remotion_composition: Step 2 of the large-zip path: after PUTting the zip to the uploadUrl from create_remotion_composition, call this with upload_complete:true t
- list_remotion_compositions: List the caller’s registered Remotion compositions with their ids, entry points and stored default props.
- create_remotion_render: Render a registered composition to MP4 (or a single PNG still) on Draftless's render worker, with new input props — iterate without the sour
- get_remotion_render: Status of a create_remotion_render job.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
